name: Deacons
overview: Scripture presents deacons as servants within the church entrusted with practical ministries, exemplified by the appointment in Acts 6 to address the neglect of widows. They serve alongside elders, who are overseers responsible for shepherding the flock purchased by Christ's blood (Acts 20:28; Philippians 1:1). The role of deacons is grounded in faithful service and blameless character, as seen in Titus 1:6 and Romans 16:1, emphasizing their commitment to Christ and the church community.
